content.title: What channel is the women's Final Four? TV, live stream, schedule
content.text: Updated April 3, 2026, 7:00 p.m. CTThe best of the best from the 2025-26 women's college basketball season have cruised into the Final Four of the 2026 Women’s NCAA Tournament.And it just happens to be the same four teams that played in last year's Final Four.For the second straight season, the Final Four features UConn, South Carolina, UCLA and Texas. It's the second time in the tournament's history there is a repeat Final Four.These are also all No. 1 seeds - just the fifth time a Final Four has included all the top seeds. And they have played like it with every margin of victory coming by double digits.In the first Final Four game, it's Geno Auriemma's undefeated UConn Huskies against Dawn Staley's powerhouse South Carolina Gamecocks in a rematch of last year's national championship game.UConn, which has a 54-game winning streak dating to February 2025, is playing in its record 25th Final Four. The 38-0 Huskies, led by national player of the year Sarah Strong, have two players from Wisconsin – Germantown's KK Arnold and Neenah's Allie Ziebell as well as University of Wisconsin transfer Serah Williams.South Carolina (35-3) is playing in a sixth straight Final Four and eighth overall in the last 11 tournaments. It's seeking a third straight appearance in the final and fourth in the last five years.In the second Final Four game, it'll be the Big Ten regular-season and tournament champion UCLA Bruins (35-1) playing the SEC tournament champion Texas Longhorns (35-3). Led by Lauren Betts, UCLA is in its second Final Four and its 35 wins are a program record.The only team to beat the Bruins this season happens to be their opponent in the Final Four. The Madison Booker-led Longhorns are in their fifth Final Four and will look to advance to the title game for the first time since winning the championship in 1986.Here are the start times and where to watch the Final Four games:What time is the UConn vs. South Carolina Final Four game?Time: 6 p.m.Date: Friday, April 3The top-seeded UConn Huskies and top-seeded South Carolina Gamecocks play at 6 p.m. in the first Final Four game at the Mortgage Matchup Center in Phoenix, Arizona.What time is the Texas vs UCLA Final Four game?Time: 8:30 p.m. or 30 minutes after the first gameDate: Friday, April 3The top-seeded Texas Longhorns and top-seeded UCLA Bruins play at approximately 8:30 p.m. on Friday, April 3, in the second Final Four game of the night at the Mortgage Matchup Center in Phoenix, Arizona.What channel are the women's Final Four games tonight?TV: ESPNBoth the UConn vs. South Carolina and Texas vs. UCLA games will broadcast on ESPN.Where to watch women's Final Four games on live streamThe women's Final Four games can be streamed on Fubo, which offers a free trial.
